title: Post title vs body headings
when_to_use: Drafting or rewriting posts/pages/articles; choosing where the H1 goes; avoiding a duplicate title heading in the block tree.
principles: In WordPress, the post/page title field is the document H1 — themes and SEO plugins usually render it as the page heading. Put the article title there, not as a core/heading level 1 in the body.
Body outline starts at heading level 2: section titles use core/heading with level 2, subsections 3–6 as needed.

While the block editor is open: set the title with ahentic-browser/update-post-document (or update-post-title), then write the body with set-blocks / insert-blocks / replace-blocks without a level-1 heading that repeats that title.
When the editor is not open: pass title on ahentic/create-post or ahentic/update-post; keep body markup free of a leading H1 that duplicates the title.
If an H1 (or title-like heading) is already in the body and should be the document title, promote it via update-post-document then delete-blocks — see playbook editor-leave-canvas.
Only keep a level-1 heading in the content when the user explicitly asks for an in-body H1, or when editing a template/pattern that is not a normal post/page title field.
steps: Write it to the post title field (update-post-document while editor open; create-post / update-post title when not).
Draft body blocks starting with paragraphs and/or core/heading level 2+ — no duplicate level-1 title block.
For long drafts: stage-artifact then set-blocks / create-post with from_memory; still keep title on the document field, not inside the staged blocks as H1.
anti_patterns: Inserting core/heading level 1 as the first block with the same text as the post title.
Leaving the post title empty/generic ("Untitled") while putting the real headline only in the body as H1.
Using ahentic/update-post for title while the same post is open in the block editor — use update-post-document instead.
Assuming every document needs an in-canvas H1 because HTML pages usually have one — in WordPress posts/pages the title field already supplies it.
